input: Find founder- or family-owned US veterinary clinic groups with 5-30 locations

output.search_notes: As of 2026-11-09, eight qualifying groups were verified. Rankings reflect thesis fit and evidence clarity, not financial performance. Location counts are company disclosures or counts of named directory entries; discrepancies are identified below. An observation date is not necessarily the underlying measurement date. Employee figures are unaudited estimates or directory counts and may undercount clinical staff. No PE acquisition was identified for the included groups, but this is not a definitive beneficial-ownership audit. Family Vet Group was excluded following its acquisition by Gryphon-backed Heartland (https://www.gryphon-inv.com/news/gryphon-backed-heartland-veterinary-partners-acquires-family-vet-group; portfolio: https://www.gryphon-inv.com/companies/heartland-veterinary-partners). Lakefield was excluded because its official site reports over 80 locations (https://lakefieldvet.com/our-story/who-we-are). This is a verified list, not an exhaustive national census. missing_fields: headcount_growth and last_round for every company; founded_year for Symbios; employees for O’Brien; direct source_url for O’Brien’s University of Florida location-count disclosure. No comparable two-date, groupwide workforce series or disclosed latest funding round was verified; null does not mean zero growth or no financing.
